Metadata.description: Management for therapy institutions: administrators, therapists, patients/clients and parents.

Landing.badge: One platform for your whole institution
Landing.description: Rooms, therapies, timetables and the institution calendar in one place, kept up to date for administrators, therapists, patients/clients and parents.
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Set up your institution once, and everyone sees a schedule that stays current.

classes.title: Rooms and therapies
classes.text: Create rooms, enrol patients/clients and give each therapy a therapist, a weekly schedule and the dates it runs.

timetable.title: Personal timetables
timetable.text: Therapists, patients/clients and parents see their own sessions by day, week or month, with a marker for right now.

timeline.title: Institution-wide timeline
timeline.text: Admins see every therapy and session across the year, grouped by room or therapist, and can zoom from a term down to a day.

calendar.title: Institution calendar
calendar.text: Assessments, trips and parents' meetings for the institution or one room. Public holidays are added for you and cancel that day's sessions.

people.title: Invitations and roles
people.text: Invite therapists, patients/clients and parents by email. Each person sees only what their role allows.

health.title: Overview and monitoring
health.text: Live numbers for your institution, and a log of errors and slow requests so problems get noticed.

Landing.rolesTitle: Made for everyone at the institution

admin.title: Institution admins
admin.text: Set up rooms, therapies and schedules, manage people and plan the calendar.

teacher.title: Therapists
teacher.text: See your timetable and your rooms, and invite your patients/clients.

student.title: Patients/Clients
student.text: Know what's next today, this week and this month.
